messages:
Rina Patel: hi all! Rina here — joining ML infra today. i brought a tin of matcha mochi to the kitchen at 10:30 if anyone wants to grab one :)
Noah Park: welcome Rina! :wave: love matcha mochi. i'll be there around 10:35 with a travel mug.
Samira K.: yum!! are they store-bought or your secret family recipe? i'll bring extra forks (or napkins) :yum:
Rina Patel: secret family recipe — vegan option in the silver tin. left a tiny sticky with ingredients. happy to share the recipe later.
DevBot: FYI: New hire orientation starts 14:00 in the conference room B. Please check in at reception for badge pickup. (automated)
Jonah L.: welcome! quick FYI on the monorail pass — stop by my desk and i can show the route (saved me so much time)
Lina R.: welcome @Rina! if you want a desk plant, ping me — we've got a "plant foster" shelf. also there's a weekly improv lunch on Thursdays if you like bad jokes :smile: 
Priya V.: hi Rina, i'm on ops — if you need VPN or access to the GPU queue i can put in the ticket now. also pro tip: microwave timings for mochi vary — watch it 15s at a time.
Noah Park: lunchtime: casual puzzle meetup in the lounge at 12:30. new hires usually join. no pressure, just snacks and a stack of sold-out mini-jigsaws.
Rina Patel: thanks everyone! i'll hang around after orientation and try the improv lunch. see you all soon :)
